references.text: Judah instructs Onan to go in to his brother's widow to fulfill the levirate duty and raise up offspring for his brother. This is the earliest biblical reference to levirate marriage.
Boaz redeems Ruth by buying land and taking her as wife to maintain the deceased's name on his inheritance. The entire book of Ruth illustrates the practice of the levirate law.
Naomi refers to the levirate law when she says she has no more sons who can become husbands for her daughters-in-law.
The Sadducees ask Jesus a question about the resurrection based on the levirate law, mentioning a woman who had been married to seven brothers in succession.
Parallel account to Matthew where the Sadducees use the levirate law to argue against the resurrection.
Luke's version of the Sadducees' question about levirate marriage and the resurrection.
